name: @capital-q/q-embeddings
description: Capital Q embedding provider boundary (CQ-RAG-002): a provider-neutral EmbeddingProvider port, versioned model/configuration descriptors, versioned query-instruction profiles, vector validation, bounded batching, health, and a local Text Embeddings Inference adapter for the open-weight Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B runtime. No hosted embedding API, no credential, no vector persistence, no retrieval.
